title: What If a Tesla Roadster Was Launched Into Deep Space?

scenes.text: What if a sports car was launched into space and never came back? One was.
In 2018 a Tesla Roadster rode a Falcon Heavy onto a path around the Sun that crosses the orbits of Earth and Mars.
Close passes keep bending its orbit, so researchers simulated millions of years of its future.
In the next million years, there is about a 6 percent chance it hits Earth, and about 2.5 percent it hits Venus.
After three million years, Earth's odds rise to about 11 percent. And in 2091 it passes within one Moon distance of us.
Its time is limited: a few tens of millions of years. That car is orbiting on borrowed time.
